# Senior By Design - llms.txt
# https://seniorbydesign.com

Senior By Design (SBD) is a boutique senior living interior design firm founded by Reid Bonner, headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The firm specializes exclusively in interior design, FF&E procurement, and space planning for senior living communities including independent living, assisted living, memory care, and active adult communities across the United States.

## About
- Founded by Reid Bonner, President
- Address: 5015 Catron Dr, Suite 200, Dallas, TX 75227
- Design Studios: Dallas (2050 N. Stemmons Fwy, Suite 555/Mail 172, Dallas TX 75207); Boulder (1045 Pearl St, Boulder CO 80403)
- Phone: (833) 773-3744
- Specialty: Senior living interior design and FF&E services
- Headquarters: Dallas, TX (with a warehouse and design center)
- Notable: Every chair specified by SBD is personally tested by the team
- Awards: TBD
- Key differentiator: Boutique, custom approach — not catalog-inspired
